description: This source file is a shell script for testing the behavior of 'git rm' with sparse checkout features. It sets up a git repository, defines various test cases to verify how 'git rm' interacts with sparse checkouts, including options like --sparse, recursive removal, and handling of sparse entries.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, runs the provided commands.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares the output or files for equality.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Verifies that the output is empty.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Checks that a given path is missing.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
